author: MuzzBuzz
body:
Hi there,
Today I have a player report regarding Alt Accounting and Map Stealing.

Reported Player(s): Da_Baus
Rules Broken: Alt Accounting
Evidence: Baus told me himself, I have a sound file, and you could just check the IP's.

pricey108 gave Baus his account so he could go on and improve his stats and K/D

If you would like to hear the sound file, please add me on skype: keaton142. Please bare in mind though that Baus saying yes is a bit hard to hear.

I am also reporting Baus for Map Stealing.

Reported Player(s): Da_Baus
Rules Broken: Map Stealing
Evidence: Baus posted this - http://avicus.net/forums/90b96c038?page=1 I found this - http://minecraftmaps.org/minecraft-pvp-maps/christmas-combat/

I find these to both be direct violations of the rules and believe that action should be taken against Da_Baus.

Your time and service to the server (Insert name of mod reading this report here) is very greatly appreciated and I thank you for taking the time to read my report.

Cheers,
Keaton
